name: Midtrans (GoTo Financial)

webhook.algorithm: NOT A HEADER. Midtrans puts signature_key INSIDE the JSON notification body. Verify with plain SHA-512 (not HMAC) of the concatenated string order_id + status_code + gross_amount + ServerKey, then compare to body.signature_key. No timestamp, no tolerance window, no replay protection — so dedup on order_id + transaction_status is mandatory. VERIFIED from docs.midtrans.com/docs/https-notification-webhooks. Additional trap: gross_amount must be used as the exact string Midtrans sent (e.g. "10000.00"); reformatting it as a number breaks the hash.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. fees.notes: Standard published rates: credit card 2.9% + IDR 2,000 per transaction; bank transfer / VA IDR 4,000 flat. No setup or subscription fee. Medium confidence — from aggregator/review sources rather than a fetched Midtrans rate card.

notes: The default Indonesian gateway for local merchants and the one whose verification scheme most reliably breaks generated code: the signature is not a header and not an HMAC. Also the cleanest path to Indonesian Virtual Account, which is still the country's dominant online rail.
SDKs: node: midtrans-client; python: midtransclient; php: midtrans/midtrans-php. All official (github.com/Midtrans).
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps Xendit in ID. Midtrans is more common among Indonesia-native merchants; Xendit is more common among regional/VC-backed ones.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
